senses.gloss:
ITA-3.15.1 Dhamanī धमनी
Artery
A pulsatile conduit. Blood vessels which pulsate in synchrony with the heartbeat.

ITA-5.73.9 dhamanīgata-śalyaḥ धमनीगत-शल्यः
Foreign body in the arteries
A disorder due to presence of foreign body in the arteries; characterized by foamy/frothy bleeding; expulsion of vayu with sounds; generalized body aches; thirst; nausea.

ITA-3.16.17 dhamanīmarma धमनीमर्म
Vulnerable location(s) in which the main structural component is pulsating vessels
Marma where pulsating vessels are structurally prominent.
